results.name: recording: each edit kind produces exactly the expected w:ins / w:del (lxml oracle); trackRevisions saved; ids unique; python-docx opens
accept-all / reject-all (ours) equal the oracle's independent resolution, on the live model and after a save/re-open
per-change review: 40 random accept/reject decisions, applied one change at a time in random order, equal the oracle
next/previous order + toggling: revisions() is in document order; turning tracking off is saved; untracked edits add no revision
typing over a selection under tracking: deleted text stays, the insertion follows it (Word order); Delete key skips past
POI corpus: every document with run revisions re-serializes (all paragraphs regenerated) with the same revisions and the same accept/reject text
